part.text: Baseline had 23 errors + 2 failures; with my fix it's 23 errors + 1 failure (the remaining one being the pre-existing environment-related `FileTest::testNotReadable`). My change fixed the removal-related failure and introduced no regressions across all 20153 tests. Final diff:

Fixed in `src/PhpSpreadsheet/ReferenceHelper.php`. Root cause: when removing columns, `insertNewBefore` is supposed to null out stale cells in the removed column range (`clearColumnStrips`) before shifting the remaining cells left, but two off-by-one conditions disabled it:

- `src/PhpSpreadsheet/ReferenceHelper.php:395` — the guard `$beforeColumn - 2 + $numberOfColumns > 0` skipped strip clearing whenever the removed range started at column A or B (e.g. `removeColumn('B')` yields exactly `0`), so existing cells in the deleted column were never cleared. Now it validates only that the strip start column is valid (`>= 1`).
- `src/PhpSpreadsheet/ReferenceHelper.php:1001` — `clearColumnStrips` looped only to `$highestRow - 1`, leaving the last row's stale cell (e.g. `B2` = `'b2'`) untouched. Now it clears through `$highestRow`.

With the stale cells nulled before the shift, missing/null source cells no longer resurrect old values into the shifted column. Verified: the issue repro now returns `a1, c1, d1 / a2, null, d2`, and the full test suite (20153 tests) shows no regressions — the only remaining failures/errors are pre-existing environment issues (no GD/fonts, root-permission `FileTest::testNotReadable`), confirmed against a stashed baseline.
